Cryptography

链上托管

The direct management and safekeeping of crypto assets by holding private keys on blockchain infrastructure, rather than relying on third-party custodians, providing transparency, auditability, and real-time asset control for institutional portfolios.

This definition is sourced from CFA Institute, IFRS Foundation, FASB (GAAP), Basel III Framework and published by Protermify Finance as a static finance reference page.

Definition

The direct management and safekeeping of crypto assets by holding private keys on blockchain infrastructure, rather than relying on third-party custodians, providing transparency, auditability, and real-time asset control for institutional portfolios.

Operational example

Crypto funds may use onchain custody to retain full asset control, comply with transparency mandates, and enable automated real-time reporting to auditors and regulators.
